front.title: A Framework for SR Policy Bandwidth Guarantee

abstract.t: This document describe a scalable framework targeting deterministic bandwidth guarantee for SR Policy candidate paths based on the Differentiated Services (DiffServ) architecture. The proposed framework separates the statically configured per-hop Quality of Service (QoS) scheduling policy from dynamic service admission and path selection managed centrally. Based on the centralized admission policy, per-path signaling state and IGP flooding on forwarding nodes can be avoided. It can be well-suited to enterprise, customer, carrier, and 5G/6G transport use cases where service classes need assured bandwidth guarantee.
